reason: Source-based consolidation of actual native-panel procedures while independent novelty12 adjudication runs. Root viewed all16 panels. No claim all6 proposals are novel; bankv16 remains frozen unchanged. No expanded reader output exists.

changes.old: If the permission requires paying a cost, pay it as instructed.
changes.new: Gift of Strength imposes its printed card-cost eligibility ceiling but requires no additional Energy payment for the Repeat, so an eligible card may be repeated with no Energy left. If the permission requires paying a cost, pay it as instructed.

changes.old: **Steady Regeneration**'s Healthy/Blighted test refers to the Blight Card, not Blight in the destination land.
changes.new: **Steady Regeneration**'s Healthy/Blighted test refers to the Blight Card, not Blight in the destination land. When adding Presence via Growth, Green may use destroyed disks instead of track disks even while disks remain on tracks: this is free while Healthy, or costs 1 Energy per destroyed disk while Blighted. This permission applies only to Growth; an ordinary Power needs its own explicit destroyed-Presence permission. Green's separate **Always** Range-2 Jungle/Wetland placement is additional to its one chosen Growth group, including when it chooses Reclaim/gain a Power. It still chooses only one of the optional groups.

changes.old: You can measure Growth placement Range **from existing Ocean Presence**, although normal Growth cannot add to the Ocean just by treating it as a Coastal Wetland.
changes.new: You can measure Growth placement Range **from existing Ocean Presence**, although normal Growth cannot add to the Ocean just by treating it as a Coastal Wetland. The Growth group explicitly adding two Presence in **any Ocean** can place them in any board's Ocean, even a board where Ocean has no Presence, without a numeric Range requirement. Its other group's Range-1 **Coastal land** placement does not permit placing in the Ocean.

changes.old: Trade **X printed Health worth of drowned Invaders for 1 Energy**, X = number of Spirits; ignore Health modifiers and make change.
changes.new: At any time, trade stored Invaders: **X printed Health worth of drowned Invaders for 1 Energy**, X = number of Spirits; ignore Health modifiers and make change. They need not be exchanged when Drowned; Ocean may exchange them between actions during a later Spirit Phase, including before paying for cards.

changes.old: **Spirits May Yet Dream** can flip any Fear Card, earned or anywhere in the deck.
changes.new: **Spirits May Yet Dream** can flip any Fear Card, earned or anywhere in the deck. Its Element-granting level gives the target Spirit one Element of a type it already has at least one of; it cannot grant a currently absent Element type.
